command:
set -euo pipefail
export DISPLAY=:0
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
export XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority
COMMIT=8102548c376b0f0bc6cc09f5b1064636f902a2b0
LIVE=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html
PRE_HASH=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
PRE_PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo PRE_HASH=$PRE_HASH
echo PRE_PID=$PRE_PID
REPO=''
for g in $(find /home/ai-core-node -maxdepth 6 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null); do r=${g%/.git}; u=$(git -C "$r" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true); case "$u" in *clay-global-research-entity*) REPO=$r; break;; esac; done
if [ -z "$REPO" ]; then echo REPO_NOT_FOUND >&2; exit 31; fi
echo REPO=$REPO
git -C "$REPO" fetch -q origin "$COMMIT"
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-v6-idle.XXXXXX)
cleanup(){ git -C "$REPO" worktree remove --force "$TMP/repo" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$TMP"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git -C "$REPO" worktree add --detach "$TMP/repo" "$COMMIT" >/dev/null
cd "$TMP/repo"
python3 -m py_compile research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/diagnose_shadow_scheduler_attribution_v2.py research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/diagnose_shadow_scheduler_visible_x11_v6.py
echo PY_COMPILE_PASS
set +e
GO_EYE_MODE=idle timeout 100s python3 research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/diagnose_shadow_scheduler_visible_x11_v6.py >"$TMP/run.out" 2>"$TMP/run.err"
RC=$?
set -e
echo RUN_RC=$RC
echo '=== RUN STDOUT ==='; cat "$TMP/run.out"
echo '=== RUN STDERR ==='; cat "$TMP/run.err"
POST_HASH=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
POST_PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo POST_HASH=$POST_HASH
echo POST_PID=$POST_PID
test "$PRE_HASH" = "$POST_HASH"
test "$PRE_PID" = "$POST_PID"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet frankenstein-buehne.service
echo PRODUCTION_INVARIANCE_PASS
exit $RC
